observations: Photo 0, 1, 2 show a games console fully wrapped in a grey/black camouflage vinyl skin, body shape consistent with an original 'fat' PlayStation 4.
A black game controller with a central light-bar strip and rounded grips sits on top of the console; its shape resembles a DualSense (PS5) controller rather than a standard DualShock 4.
No power cable, HDMI cable, game discs, cases, or a PSN/game library screen are shown in any photo.
No serial number, model plate, or power-on/boot screen is visible; the skin covers any identifying labels.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'STEVAN ZIDIRI' are overlaid on all three photos; no additional angles (rear ports, bottom, screen-on) are provided.

claims.evidence: No boot screen, menu, or jailbreak software screenshot shown in any photo.

claims.evidence: No discs, cases, or digital library screenshot shown in any photo.

risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together.

proof_requests: A video of the console powering on and loading a game or menu.
A screenshot of the jailbreak/firmware menu proving the 'hacked' claim.
Close-up photos of the controller's back and buttons to confirm model and compatibility.
Photos of the actual game discs/cases or digital library listing all 6 titles.
A photo with the skin peeled back or rear port view to confirm PS4 variant and check for damage.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a skinned PS4 console with a controller of uncertain compatibility, but none of the seller's claims (hacked status, working condition, included games) are shown in the photos, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, untested console with no confirmed games or accessories.
